title: רב המנונא בריה דרב יוסף
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rav Hamnuna, son of Rav Yosef: “I stood before Rava, and he told me, ‘Bring tefillin’”: Berakhot 24a; so too Rif. But Asheri’s reading is Rabbi Nechemyah, son of Rav Yosef (see his entry). Newer Talmud editions did not correct it.
